title: hardcoded date in run_post_pipeline test breaks after 2026-04-21T12:00 UTC
description: lifecycle.rs test helper minimal_article() hardcodes 'Date: Mon, 20 Apr 2026 12:00:00 +0000'. run_post_pipeline calls complete_post → validate_post_headers → check_date which enforces ±24h from SystemTime::now(). Trigger: run cargo test after 2026-04-21 12:00:00 UTC (which may already have passed). Bad behavior: post_then_over_returns_article test fails with '441 Date header out of acceptable range'. Fix: use a dynamically computed current-ish date string in the test.
